event: S81 serdes plain relay (relay_lockup negedge -> plain posedge relay on the 11 serdes types)
question: COORD 11-11: the event relies on kit hold repair doing ~332 ps FF on one relay hop (estimate: t2 pad sum 2797 ps FF over 24 hops; vC t14 worst hop -331.9 ps FF). What bounds that repair?
answer: (a) written reason with one measured repair; recommended for the hold side, with a residual SETUP item on 3 long t14 relay hops (below)
what_bounds_the_repair: Pad cell: hold_pad_hb4.tcl allows HB4xp67 only inside repair_timing -hold (~37-47 ps FF per cell; ~332 ps = 7-9 HB4 on one net; BUFx2 ~15-17 ps would need ~20)
Tool buffer cap: hold_repair_pre.tcl raises repair_timing -max_buffer_percent to OT_MAX_BUFFER_PERCENT 100 (config.mk), so the ORFS 20 % cap (RSZ-0060) does not stop it

Hop setup slack: the pad is bounded by the hop's TT setup slack after the half cycle the plain relay gains (estimate: setup_after = TT setup + 416.5, pad at TT = FF pad x 1.33, 0 hops negative after pad on the 3 estimated types); repair_timing -hold does not insert past setup, so a hop that is both hold- and setup-short stays setup-negative instead

measured_repair.W: W=180 ps (vT3 kit SDC: set_clock_latency -source -early -180 on every clk_t* port; the plan fe0e3577f657 per_type_ps for serdes__t14 is 116)
measured_repair.db: epyc8 /srv/opentallas-scratch2/claude/die-s81-85/serdes14_vT3/gen/serdes__t14 run/results/asap7/dp_serdes__t14/base/4_cts.odb sha256 84a9d8fec820 (post-CTS, placement RC setRC_rcx, read-only)
measured_repair.method: the kit's own FF hold-gate session (hold_gate.tcl head: FF libs, vclk FF binding, seam IO contract, propagated clocks); the 98 relay flops u_bound.u_rrl_*/q (DFFLQNx1/x2, negedge) re-mastered to DFFHQNx1 (posedge = the plain relay); then repair_timing -hold -hold_margin 5 -max_buffer_percent 100 with HB4xp67 un-dont_used, as the kit's PRE_GLOBAL_ROUTE hook does; TT setup re-timed on the repaired DB

FF_hold_design.before: -331.2 ps / 4067 endpoints (u_enc cross-tap class, not the relays)

repair_cost.note: the count is design-wide; most pads are on the u_enc cross-tap class, not on the relays

TT_setup_design.after_plain_and_repair: -471.7 ps / 1546 (pads on non-relay classes; not attributed per class here)

recommendation: (a): repair closes the worst plain-relay hop on t14 (-309 ps FF, close to the 332 ps in question) and the whole design to +5 ps FF hold at CTS/placement RC. The +1-relay-stage variant (b) is not needed for hold. The 3 setup-negative t14 hops (53->59, 74->79, 84->88) are long wire hops that miss setup even with a full cycle; that is a separate distance item (a closer relay placement or +1 relay stage on those 3 hops only, +1 reset-release cycle each), not part of the hold dependency.
not_verified: only serdes__t14 is measured by repair (vT3 DB, CTS stage, placement RC, not GRT/routed); t2 (the 332 ps / 2797 ps case) and t16 are estimate-only; the other 8 types (t12, t13, t15__cla2127225, t15__cla3d02796, t1__clb45db5be, t1__clfe1f0815, t3, t4) are UNMEASURED
the vT3 DB carries W=180, not the per-port window of SERDES-KITWIN-1111; with smaller windows the u_enc cross-tap hold demand drops
the TT setup cost of the pads is measured after repair only; the plain-relay-before-repair TT setup was not timed separately
the estimate's raw per-hop probe data (vC t14 / t2 / vC t16 DBs) was not found any more, so estimate.json was not re-derived
